name: Periwinkles On Cherry St
hours: Mon 10:30 AM–5 PM; Tue 10:30 AM–5 PM; Wed 10:30 AM–5 PM; Thu 10:30 AM–5 PM; Fri 10:30 AM–5 PM; Sat 10:30 AM–5 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: Shopping at Periwinkles was delightful! I found linen and batik figure-flattering outfits and a turquoise necklace. Prices were reasonable so I didn’t have to leave without anything I loved. You must try on something and see the uniquely decorated dressing rooms. Excellent customer care!

I totally disagree with Eric Wilson. There are some very comfortable loosefitting tops for women who aren't skinny. And Connie the manager is delightful. I think it's a great little store and worth stopping in

Super cute boutique in the heart of Black Mountain with lots of unique clothing, locally made jewelry, hand-knitted scarves (with a selection of novelty yarn, and hand-sewn accent pieces to complete your outfit.

Has pretty clothing and some of it is unique, but the employee/shop owner is terribly unfriendly if you don't fit a certain norms. All the clothing is geared towards really thin women and the prices are, well, pricey....
lovely store the layout is gorgeous. Many one of a kind art to wear. Friendly shop owners.
Absolutely love this store the lady there helped me so much I couldnt have ask for a better shopping experience
The person behind the counter, who I assume is the owner, was very rude to my wife. Interesting way to run a business.
